mentions.name: AI assistant plugin for Logseq
mentions.description: An open source Logseq plugin that lets users chat with their Logseq graph. It answers questions about a specific block while drawing on the contents of the entire graph, described as a "Cursor for Logseq". The plugin is a work in progress and fully open source.
mentions.problem: The author repeatedly wished they could easily ask questions about a specific block in their Logseq graph and get an intelligent response also influenced by the contents of the whole graph.
mentions.source_excerpt: An AI assistant plugin for Logseq. https://github.com/shovon/logseq-ai
